arguments.sql: SELECT t.transaction_type, 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE t.transaction_type IN ('Chip Transaction', 'Online Transaction', 'Swipe Transaction') GROUP BY t.transaction_type ORDER BY t.transaction_type
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate for each of the three transaction types (chip, online, swipe), using only labelled transactions.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only; unlabelled transactions are excluded rather than treated as legitimate.
Covers the full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
